findings.claim: Active workflow_dispatch job executes control_sha-selected candidate tests on the privileged trusted self-hosted runner.
A second active self-hosted workflow executes the event-ref source and tests; the current path verifier does not deny this workflow path.
The active verifier does not default-deny all .github/workflows paths; candidate workflow additions/changes outside two named paths can evade this path gate.

required_closure: Run ordinary candidate tests only on GitHub-hosted unprivileged runners.
Restrict privileged runner execution to an immutable trusted verifier workflow; candidate source is data only and is never executed there.
Default-deny the complete .github/workflows namespace and trust-root/template paths in the immutable verifier, with explicitly qualified exact blob exceptions only.
Retire or convert v45-bounded-self-hosted.yml so it cannot execute code from a candidate-selected ref on the privileged runner.
Read back provider runner-group allowlist and branch/ruleset controls from an authorized provider-admin route.
Bind every protected result to exact base/head/tree/path/blob identities and do not transfer mirror results.
